Fraichoù: A French App That Finds the Coolest Walking Routes During Heat Waves

📅 2026-07-07 ✍️ Antoine Roche, Les Numériques 🏷️ Fraichoù, heat wave routing, Google Maps alternative, walking routes, shade routing, urban heat, pedestrian navigation, France, isochrone, canicule
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

A French engineer launches Fraichoù, a web app that finds the coolest walking routes through cities by factoring in shade from buildings, trees, and water features — a niche Google Maps doesn't address as heat waves make pedestrian travel increasingly uncomfortable.

📌 Key takeaways

  • Fraichoù is a French web app that finds the freshest (coolest) walking routes, currently available in Paris, Lille, and Rennes
  • Users enter departure point, destination, and time to get three route options: fastest, balanced, or coolest
  • The "coolest" route factors in shade from buildings, trees, and water features to minimize heat exposure
  • Toggles display shade sources (buildings, trees, water) for better route understanding
  • Addresses a gap in Google Maps, which optimizes for speed but not thermal comfort for pedestrians
